short: RAVEn's momentum-teacher objective (M03) is new but ties AV-HuBERT at Large with 30 h (32.5% WER); most of its later gain comes from ASR pseudo-labels (M02), single runs.
position: The paper [@haliassos2023raven] changes the pre-training objective (M03), momentum-teacher latents predicted asymmetrically across modalities, and the form of training-only audio supervision (M02); both stay standard. At Large, 1,759 h unlabelled and 30 h labelled without self-training or LM, its 32.5% VSR WER equals AV-HuBERT's 32.5% [@shi2022avhubert], so the claim to surpass all self-supervised methods rests on Base models, 27.8% against 28.6% with 433 h labelled, and self-training, all single runs. The largest VSR gain after pre-training (32.5% to 24.8%) comes from pseudo-labels from the fine-tuned audio encoder, the usual audio-teacher route. The 90,000-hour comparison passes over the 19.3% listed in the same table. USR 2.0 now reaches 23.7% at the same budget [@haliassos2026usr2] [later].
